text:
anshul: quick question — for tenant-level pinning should we expose a 'pin_selector' vs only an exact model id? i.e. allow tenants to pin to a model family (e.g. 'luma-3.1') or a compatibility band instead of an immutable content-hash?

sam: i like the family idea for UX. lets ops push security/patch updates under the hood without breaking customers. downside: semantics get fuzzy.

vivian: we discussed this in the rfc a bit. if we expose families we should be explicit: soft vs hard pin. soft=family affinity + auto-roll for critical patches, hard=exact content-hash and no automatic upgrades. clients must opt in.

joel: ops angle: family pins change routing determinism. we need to ensure capacity accounting and fallback deterministic ordering. also want telemetry to know when "family" resolved to which content-hash.

carla: proposal for metadata fields: `pin_scope` (tenant|route|call), `pin_mode` (hard|soft|semver_band), `selector` (exact|family|compatibility), `fallback_order` (list of selectors). example:```json
{
  "pin_scope": "tenant",
  "pin_mode": "soft",
  "selector": "family",
  "family": "luma-3.1",
  "fallback_order": ["family","exact"]
}
```
This keeps client surface small and lets control plane resolve to content-hash and emit resolution events.

anshul: +1 to that shape. we should also add `resolution_ttl` so control plane re-resolves families periodically (and invalidate caches on emergency patches).

vivian: add `resolution_audit` boolean to request that forces the system to include which content-hash was served in the call-level response (useful for audits).

joel: a couple implementation concerns: 1) index lookups per-request for family->hash must be cheap (cache + watch events). 2) rollout policies: when family maps to multiple variants we need deterministic fallback sort (maybe stable weight then age).

infra-bot: note: creating ticket INF-7234 to etag family-index, and adding family->hash change webhook for Dedicated customers.

anshul: action items i captured: 1) formalize schema PR with fields carla suggested + resolution_ttl + resolution_audit. 2) migration plan for existing tenant pins (default to hard exact). 3) add telemetry events: family_resolution, fallback_used. i'll draft the PR.

vivian: sounds good. i'd want a short migration playbook in the PR body. :thumbsup:

carla: will add sample curl/SDK snippets for both soft and hard pin flows in the PR.

anshul: thanks all — i'll ping the rfc thread and link PR when ready.
